postprocess.54: PNG不烧文字／箭头。排版时沿三个小范围球位补同一小圈路线箭头，先顺时针、停住后逆时针；逆向复用同姿势，箭头分别明确方向，不把取样点当连续大圈或扩大圈径。

qa_overall: 七个选用帧已逐张view_image查看；人物身份、正常比例、灰蓝棚拍背景、关键手指与接触符合画稿要求。两张首稿返修，未覆盖原文件；未宣称临床协议或动作效果验收。

frames.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: ONE photoreal rehabilitation key-position photograph, wall small-ball circles, step 01. Input images 1-3 are the fixed character/style identity references: preserve exactly the same East Asian adult woman, recognizable face, black ponytail, plain white short sleeve T-shirt, dark charcoal gray trousers, realistic normal adult body proportions, soft studio photography, identical light gray-blue palette. Image 4 is the action scene/reference to edit. Create one single photo with NO words, labels, arrows, collage, marks or watermark. She faces a vertical gray-blue wall and stands steadily on the same plain gray-blue floor, white sneakers; one hand presses a small soft gray ball flat against the wall just below shoulder level in front of her shoulder. Other arm relaxed at side. Palm and fingers clearly touch the ball, ball touches wall; hand/ball/wall contact is visibly realistic, no floating ball or glued wall fixture. Use a slightly frontward three-quarter camera that clearly shows her recognizable face and shoulder, active hand and fingers, ball and wall contact. Full body head to shoes safely in frame, natural anatomy and scale, not elongated. This is the first sampling position on ONE very small circular route; do NOT add a drawn circle. For the subsequent two frames only hand-ball position will shift subtly along that same small circle while camera, woman, feet, torso and wall remain fixed. Keep the character, clothing, lighting and background color unchanged.
source: E:/git冲突问题/rehab image/assess/054_E-AXU-027_墙面持球小圈控制观察.png

frames.limitations: 小圈方向仅靠静态样本不能表达，需后期小圆路线方向箭头。

frames.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve, tightly controlled pose edit. Images 1-3 define same exact woman and gray-blue style. Image 4 is wall-ball frame 01 to edit, NOT a new pose or new camera. Make a single frame02 by a TINY LATERAL shift of the ball and pressing hand on wall, without raising her arm. Preserve the entire rest of image4: exact head/face, ponytail, relaxed other arm, torso/shoulders, both feet and shoes, camera, crop, wall and lighting. Ball centre MUST remain at the SAME VERTICAL height as image4, in front of and a little below the shoulder, at about 23.7 percent of full image height (approximately y333 on this 1402-high composition). Move ball centre only slightly RIGHT on the wall from about x834 to about x858 on the 1122-wide image, a quarter of the ball diameter. This is one side sample on a very small wall circle, NOT overhead/shoulder flexion or a large circle. Palm and whole fingers remain pressing the same soft gray ball against wall, no floating. Keep elbow relaxed slightly bent with only minimal forearm adjustment. Absolutely no upward ball lift, no raised shoulder, no text, arrows, labels, circle, collage or watermark. Match exact reference woman white T dark trousers, normal real proportions and photoreal photography.
frames.qa: 已查看v2：人物、机位、站位保持；球与掌墙持续接触，球位仅小幅侧移且高度与s01接近，未再抬至肩上。
frames.limitations: 静态图只能呈现同一小圈的取样位置，不能独立证明闭合轨迹；需后期明确小圈顺／逆时针箭头，箭头不得扩大动作圈或烧入原始PNG。

Her palm still presses the SAME small soft ball continuously against the SAME wall just below shoulder level. frames.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve, targeted repair. Images 1-3 lock woman/style; image 4 is the straight-arm frame to repair; image 5 is the original bent-elbow frame providing the exact correct foot footprints and floor positions. Make ONE corrected straight-arm photo. Critical correction: the feet in image 4 were mistakenly moved farther from wall. Reposition BOTH white shoes and feet closer to the wall so they occupy the SAME footprint locations as image 5, while keeping both heels and soles planted and anatomically connecting lower legs naturally. Shoes must match the relative wall-floor corner distance and the original positions shown by image 5. Preserve image 4's straight natural elbows, both palms and fingers on the EXACT same wall spots, recognizable head/face, body proportions, clothing, camera and gray-blue lighting/background. Shoulder-hip-ankle alignment must remain comfortable with no folding waist; adjust lower leg alignment only as required by corrected anchored feet. Do not move hands, wall, camera, crop, change scale, add props or text. Full head and both shoes, no cut fingers. Single photoreal photograph, no arrows, lettering, collage or watermark.

frames.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Images 1-3 are fixed character/style references; image 4 shows the same woman's elbow bend but is NOT the required body position. Create ONE single rehabilitation photo of this exact woman STANDING naturally, NO chair, NO props, with comfortable elbow extension. Keep her recognizable East Asian face, black ponytail, plain white T-shirt, dark charcoal trousers, natural anatomy and normal adult body proportions, and exact gray-blue studio palette and soft photographic lighting. Camera is a fixed side view facing the plane of elbow movement, crop from above head to upper thighs so shoulder, elbow, wrist and entire hand are all clearly inside frame. Woman faces right. The near/test upper arm hangs relaxed vertically close against her side, shoulder relaxed; elbow is comfortably extended with a very small natural bend, not locked or hyperextended, forearm points downward by her thigh, empty hand naturally relaxed. Far arm relaxed at side and not assisting. Natural five-finger hand. Leave ample margin around test hand. In the next frame only forearm rotates upward around this fixed elbow so hand nears shoulder; maintain the exact near upper arm, shoulder, torso, feet, camera and framing. No text, numbers, arrows, watermark, collage, weights, chair or other person's hand.
